name: 13212 · N Syracuse, NY
findings: ZIP 13212 (N Syracuse) has 65 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 13212 (N Syracuse) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 13212 (N Syracuse) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 34 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.
